## Convx 2.1.2

### Download
- **`convx-2.1.2.apk`**: one APK for every 64-bit ARM phone, which is almost every phone from the last ~8 years.

Releases now ship this single APK. Old 32-bit phones, emulators and Chromebooks are no longer covered.

### Fixes
- The selected side of the Song/Video switch in the player is readable again. Behind light artwork it came out near-white and hid its white label.
- In-app updates download the single release APK.
